description: AgroClimate—Tools for Managing Climate Risk in Agriculture is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Florida | IFAS Extension; Auburn University; Clemson University. This resource supports decision support and learning covering agriculture in the southeastern United States. Find interactive tools and data to improve crop management decisions and reduce production risks associated with climate variability, climate change, and extreme weather events. Coverage: the southeastern United States. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Vector-Borne Disease. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
